name: Vampiric Aura heals a Necromancer below 50% health from Undead minion damage (#478)
contract: Vampiric Aura 300241 (CharacterAdvancement 6458, Class tab) reads "While you are below 50% health, your Undead minions now heal you for $560607s2% of their damage dealt." 300241 is a passive whose effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL every 1000 ms on 560607 (SpellDuration 39 = 2000 ms). 560607's effect 1 is SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS with SpellRadius 12 = 100 yd and EffectBasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10, so every summon near the Necromancer carries 560607 from its owner; 561095 is the SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL the tooltip's heal is delivered with. AscensionNecromancerEvents.cpp handles it natively for minion damage (46bf8121e): below 50% health, a hit from a minion that carries the owner's 560607 casts 561095 on the owner for 10% of that hit. Two identical Necromancers each raise a Ghoul and attack their own golem; only the one set to 500 health (below half of any level-80 maximum) is healed by 561095, and the one at full health is not. Regeneration is disabled for both. This scenario is evidence for behaviour that already works; the heal's exact 10% ratio is not isolated here, because the golem's health loss also includes the owner's own swings.
